definitions.explanation: salmon, particularly when referring to the fish used in Japanese cuisine like sushi or sashimi

examples.japanese: サーモン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧サーモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate salmon at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant.

examples.japanese: サーモン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カルパッチョ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧: salmon — the native word, usually for Pacific salmon eaten cooked, such as grilled salmon at breakfast; サーモン suggests farmed Atlantic salmon or trout served raw

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サーモン⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧ - salmon sushi
- サーモン{丼|どん} - salmon rice bowl
- サーモン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ - salmon sashimi
- スモークサーモン - smoked salmon
- サーモンマリネ - marinated salmon

CULTURAL NOTE:
サーモン is one of the most popular sushi toppings in Japan, especially at ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧ (conveyor belt sushi) restaurants. It was not traditionally used in Edo-style sushi but became popular in the 1980s-90s.
